who.value: experienced seller hosting a live TCG auction on desktop

job.value: Run the live auction: start lots, watch bids and chat, manage the shop

arrivedFrom.value: Starting a scheduled show from the seller console

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Trading Card Live Auction', the video preview, 'Lots', 'Shop items', 'Live stats' and 'Chat & activities' read as a live-selling console.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The current lot 'SB02 Quickfire · 12 bids · 00:44' is central, but there's no clear primary control beyond a green '+' button tucked in the Shop table.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Mute' is clear but 'Antisniping' and 'Auction tiers' under the lot don't say what tapping them does.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Antisniping', 'Auction tiers' and 'Ready to …' in Live stats come without explanation.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The seller acts on lots and chat they set up themselves.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Every sold lot shows 'Payment Status' and a full 'Order ID' UUID mid-show, when the host is focused on the auction.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Post-sale order IDs and payment status belong to fulfilment rather than to running the live auction.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The tables are scannable, but lot rows carry three lines of text each and the panels are dense.
